sources.title: Reciprocal bidirectional plasticity of parallel fiber receptive fields in cerebellar Purkinje cells and their afferent interneurons
sources.key_finding: 逆向双向可塑性：PF+CF 配对时 PC LTD、MLI LTP；PF 单独时 PC LTP、MLI LTD。CF 信号是整个回路的可塑性方向协调器
sources.limitations: 猫在体实验，感受野为间接指标，未明确分子机制

sources.title: Specialized connectivity of molecular layer interneuron subtypes leads to disinhibition and synchronous inhibition of cerebellar Purkinje cells
sources.key_finding: MLI1（Gjd2+，电偶联，直接抑制 PC）vs MLI2（Nxph1+，无电偶联，抑制 MLI1 → 去抑制 PC）双亚型架构
sources.limitations: 未直接测试学习范式；MLI2 因果功能尚待验证

sources.title: Regulation and functional roles of rebound potentiation at cerebellar stellate cell-Purkinje cell synapses
sources.key_finding: RP 机制综述：Ca²⁺ → β-CaMKII → GABARAP → GABA_A 受体增加；转基因阻断 RP → VOR 适应受损
sources.limitations: 综述，主要基于体外实验；γ2 肽链特异性有待完善

sources.title: Interneuron- and GABA(A) receptor-specific inhibitory synaptic plasticity in cerebellar Purkinje cells
sources.key_finding: 篮状细胞→PC 突触特异性 LTP：依赖 β2-GABA_A + CaMKII；星状细胞突触不发生同类 LTP
sources.limitations: 体外实验，功能意义尚待行为学验证

sources.title: Long-term synaptic plasticity in cerebellar stellate cells
sources.key_finding: 星状细胞 PF 突触的 AMPAR 亚型切换（GluR2-无 → GluR2-含）；减小 Ca²⁺ 通透性和 EPSP 幅度
sources.limitations: 仅摘要；机制与行为连接尚待证明

sources.title: Signaling cascade regulating long-term potentiation of GABA(A) receptor responsiveness in cerebellar Purkinje neurons
sources.key_finding: RP 信号通路：钙调磷酸酶 → DARPP-32 去磷酸化 → PP1 释放 → CaMKII 状态调节
sources.limitations: 仅摘要；具体信号逻辑与最新综述存在细节差异

sources.title: Differential Modulation of GABAA Receptors Underlies Postsynaptic Depolarization- and Purinoceptor-Mediated Enhancement of Cerebellar Inhibitory Transmission
sources.key_finding: RP 增加 GABA_A 受体数量（不改变电导）；ATP-LTP 改变电导（不改变数量）——两种独立机制
sources.limitations: 机制层面，行为意义尚未直接测试

sources.title: Purkinje cell-specific knockout of the protein phosphatase PP2B impairs potentiation and cerebellar motor learning
sources.key_finding: 三种 AMPAR 内吞阻断突变 → LTD 消失但运动学习正常；说明 LTD 非必要；背景文献
sources.limitations: 仅解释现象，未指明代偿机制
